questions.stem: 令經濟學家意外的是，在某些製造業，自動化（automation）所創造的工作竟是它所淘汰的兩倍。
questions.answer: What surprises economists is that in some manufacturing industries, automation has created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated.
accepted_answers: What has surprised economists is that in certain manufacturing industries, automation has created twice as many jobs as it has wiped out.
What economists find surprising is that in some manufacturing industries, automation actually creates twice as many jobs as it eliminates.

patterns: 倍數比較（twice as many … as）

questions.stem: 然而，無論年紀多大，被機器取代的勞工都必須學習新技能，才能勝任這些新工作。
questions.answer: However, no matter how old they are, the workers replaced by machines must learn new skills to be qualified for these new jobs.
accepted_answers: However, no matter how old they may be, the workers replaced by machines have to acquire new skills so that they can handle these new jobs.
No matter how old they are, however, workers replaced by robots must learn new skills in order to take on these new jobs.

patterns: 分詞片語後位修飾（N + p.p.）

1.explanation_zh: 「令經濟學家意外的是」整段是主詞，用 what 子句：What surprises economists is that …（that 帶出後面的事實）。「製造業」是 manufacturing (industries)。「竟是它所淘汰的兩倍」是倍數比較：automation has created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated（jobs 可數，用 many；用現在完成式表示到目前為止的結果，用現在式說一般情況也可以）。「自動化」題目已附英文 automation。
1.strategy_zh: 看到「令…的是」先想 What + V + O + is that …；「是…的兩倍」用 twice as many/much + N + as …，前後兩個動詞的時態要一致。
hints: 切成四段：令經濟學家意外的是／在某些製造業／自動化所創造的工作／竟是它所淘汰的兩倍
標的詞彙：surprise（使意外）、economist（經濟學家）、manufacturing（製造業）、create（創造）、job（工作）、twice（兩倍）、eliminate（淘汰、消除）
句型框架：What + V + O + is that …, S + has p.p. + twice as many + N + as + S + has p.p.

2.explanation_zh: 「無論年紀多大」用 no matter how old they are（＝however old they are），how old 要放在一起、子句用直述句語序。「被機器取代的勞工」用過去分詞片語後位修飾：workers replaced by machines（＝workers who have been replaced by machines）。「才能勝任」表目的，用 to be qualified for／in order to handle …；「都」是語氣，不必譯 all。
2.strategy_zh: 「被…的＋名詞」先寫名詞，再接 p.p. + by …；「無論多＋形容詞」用 No matter how + adj. + S + V。
hints: 切成四段：然而，無論年紀多大／被機器取代的勞工／都必須學習新技能／才能勝任這些新工作
標的詞彙：replace（取代）、machine（機器）、worker（勞工）、learn（學習）、skill（技能）、qualified（能勝任的）
句型框架：However, no matter how + adj. + S + V, N + p.p. + by … + must + V … + to + V …

references: What surprises economists is that in some manufacturing industries, automation has created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated.
What has surprised economists is that in certain manufacturing industries, automation has created twice as many jobs as it has wiped out.
What economists find surprising is that in some manufacturing industries, automation actually creates twice as many jobs as it eliminates.

patterns.label_zh: what 引導的名詞子句當主詞（令…的是）

patterns.frame: S + V + twice as many + N + as + S + V

accepted: What has surprised economists is that
What economists find surprising is that

common_errors.explanation_zh: 「令…意外的是」整段當主詞要用 what 子句；若用 It surprises economists that …，後面就不能再接 is。

common_errors.wrong: The surprise of economists is that
common_errors.explanation_zh: 照字面把「意外」寫成名詞 the surprise of …，意思變成「經濟學家的驚喜」，不自然。
「製造業」是 manufacturing (industry)；manufacture 是動詞「製造」。
「製造業」有固定說法 manufacturing，不要逐字翻成 making。
現在完成式是 has + 過去分詞 created。
自動化是「創造」工作的一方，用主動語態，不是被創造。

accepted: twice as many jobs as it has eliminated
twice as many jobs as it has wiped out
twice as many jobs as it eliminates
twice as many jobs as it has destroyed

common_errors.wrong: two times jobs than it has eliminated
common_errors.right: twice as many jobs as it has eliminated
common_errors.explanation_zh: 倍數比較是 twice／X times + as many + 名詞 + as …（或 twice the number of …）；than 只能配比較級。

common_errors.wrong: twice as much jobs as it has eliminated
common_errors.right: twice as many jobs as it has eliminated
common_errors.explanation_zh: jobs 是可數名詞，用 many 不用 much。

traps.literal_error: Let economists surprised is that automation …
traps.explanation_zh: 「令…意外的是」不是祈使句的 let，整段是句子的主詞，要寫成 What surprises economists is that …。

traps.literal_error: … automation has created twice as many jobs as it has knocked out.
traps.explanation_zh: 工作被「淘汰」是消失、被取代，用 eliminate／wipe out；knock out 是比賽中「淘汰對手」。

bonus.text: To the surprise of many economists, automation has generated twice as many jobs as it has eliminated in some manufacturing industries.
bonus.explanation_zh: To the surprise of …（令…驚訝的是）是強調情緒的正式寫法；generate（產生）也可替換 create。

1.restructuring_zh: 「令…意外的是」英文用 What surprises … is that 開頭；「自動化所創造的工作是它所淘汰的兩倍」不要寫成 The jobs automation created are twice of …，改成以 automation 為主詞：automation has created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated。

references: However, no matter how old they are, the workers replaced by machines must learn new skills to be qualified for these new jobs.
However, no matter how old they may be, the workers replaced by machines have to acquire new skills so that they can handle these new jobs.
No matter how old they are, however, workers replaced by robots must learn new skills in order to take on these new jobs.

patterns.label_zh: 讓步：無論多…（no matter how + adj.）
patterns.frame: No matter how + adj. + S + V, S + V …

patterns.label_zh: 過去分詞片語後位修飾名詞（被…的 N）

accepted: However, no matter how old they are
However, no matter how old they may be
No matter how old they are, however

common_errors.wrong: However, no matter how old are they
common_errors.right: However, no matter how old they are
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter how + 形容詞後面用直述句語序 they are。

common_errors.wrong: However, no matter their age is
common_errors.right: However, no matter how old they are
common_errors.explanation_zh: no matter 後面接 wh- 子句（how old they are）；寫成 their age is 結構不完整。

accepted: workers who have been replaced by machines
workers who are replaced by machines

common_errors.explanation_zh: 勞工是「被」取代，後位修飾要用過去分詞 replaced。
分詞片語帶有 by …，要放在名詞後面。
這裡的「都」只是配合「無論」的語氣，不必譯成 all。
技能可數，泛指時用複數 skills。

accepted: to be qualified for these new jobs
so that they can handle these new jobs
in order to take on these new jobs

common_errors.right: to be qualified for these new jobs
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「勝任」是有能力做好，用 be qualified for／handle／take on；win 是「贏得」。

common_errors.wrong: to be qualified these new jobs
common_errors.right: to be qualified for these new jobs
common_errors.explanation_zh: be qualified 後面接 for + 工作。

traps.literal_error: … workers replaced by machines must learn new skills to win these new jobs.
traps.explanation_zh: 「勝任」是能力足以做好，不是「贏得」；用 be qualified for／handle／take on these new jobs。

traps.literal_error: However, no matter how old they are, replaced by machines workers must learn new skills …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「被…的」放在名詞前；英文帶 by 的分詞片語要放在名詞後面：workers replaced by machines。

bonus.text: However old they may be, workers displaced by automation must pick up new skills if they are to qualify for these emerging jobs.
bonus.explanation_zh: However + 形容詞 + S + may be 是 no matter how 的正式寫法；displaced（被迫離開原職）、emerging（新興的）、be to（若要…）讓句子更精準。

2.restructuring_zh: 「被機器取代的勞工」中文修飾語在前，英文改成名詞＋過去分詞片語 workers replaced by machines；「…才能勝任」改成表目的的不定詞 to be qualified for …，放在句尾。

1.translation: To the surprise of economists, in some manufacturing industries, automation has actually created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated.
1.explanation_zh: 「令……意外的是」用 To the surprise of...；「竟」譯 actually；「所創造的工作是它所淘汰的兩倍」用倍數比較 twice as many jobs as；研究發現到目前為止的結果用現在完成式。

2.translation: However, no matter how old they are, workers who have been replaced by machines must learn new skills in order to be qualified for these new jobs.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論年紀多大」用 no matter how old they are；「被機器取代的勞工」用含被動的關係子句；「才能勝任」用目的 in order to be qualified for。

issues_zh: 盲譯時「令經濟學家意外的是」自然寫成 To the surprise of economists，沒有用 What + V + is that 名詞子句：中文同樣能引出介系詞片語寫法，NCL 不是唯一自然的句構。
第 1 部分 accepted 只收 What 子句，卻沒收 To the surprise of (many) economists／To economists' surprise；而本題 bonus 本身就用 To the surprise of many economists，依現行規準寫出加分寫法的學生第 1 部分反而拿不到分，規準前後矛盾，應補進 accepted。
「竟」只有參考譯文 2 用 actually 表達，可考慮在參考譯文 0、1 也表現出來（不影響正確性）。
盲譯時「被機器取代的勞工」自然寫成關係子句 workers who have been replaced by machines，沒有用過去分詞後位修飾（PART）；第 2 部分 accepted 本來就收關係子句寫法，所以中文題目並沒有逼出 PART，標的句型的要求和評分規準不一致。
建議（不影響判定）：第 4 部分可補「in order to be qualified for these new jobs」。

1.translation: To economists' surprise, in some manufacturing industries, automation has created twice as many jobs as it has eliminated.
1.explanation_zh: 「令經濟學家意外的是」譯成 to economists' surprise；「兩倍」用倍數比較 twice as many … as；創造與淘汰是累積結果，用現在完成式；eliminate 對應「淘汰」。

2.translation: However, no matter how old they are, workers who have been replaced by machines must learn new skills in order to be qualified for these new jobs.
2.explanation_zh: 「無論年紀多大」用 no matter how old they are（也可用 regardless of their age）；「被機器取代的勞工」用關係子句加被動；「才能勝任」用 in order to be qualified for 表目的。

issues_zh: 我的譯文用 To economists' surprise, … 這個常見且正確的說法，但 references 與各部分 accepted 只收 What surprises economists is that 一類的 what 子句（bonus 的 To the surprise of many economists 也沒進 accepted）；中文「令經濟學家意外的是」不一定引出 what 子句（NCL）。建議 accepted 補上 To economists' surprise／To the surprise of economists，或放寬 NCL 標的。

第 2 部分的 accepted 收了 workers who have been replaced by machines、workers who are replaced by machines 這類關係子句寫法，但同一部分的標的句型是 PART（過去分詞片語後位修飾）；用關係子句的學生算在可接受寫法內，卻沒有用到 PART。我自己就用了關係子句，所以 PART 沒有自然用到。建議刪掉關係子句寫法，或把標的改成接受關係子句。
